# asc_vpc (Resource)

Manages an ASC VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_vpc" "example" {
  name = "example-vpc"
  cidr = "10.0.0.0/16"

  subnets = [{
    name = "bootstrap"
    cidr = "10.0.0.0/25"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC, such as 10.0.0.0/16. Every inline subnet must lie within it. Changing it replaces the VPC.
- `name` (String)
- `subnets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the VPC. Changing these tags updates the VPC in place. Changing tags on an inline subnet replaces the VPC.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_error` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `urn` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Required:

- `cidr` (String)
- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `tags` (Map of String)
- `type` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated: ASC no longer has subnet types. The value is ignored and never sent to ASC.
